checkpoint_dir.description: Checkpoint path. Accepts a checkpoint-* directory or a run-* directory (the latest checkpoint inside the run-* is used).

framework.description: Benchmark framework(s) to evaluate on. One or more of: pgym, pbc_zeroshot_contact, pbc_supervised, pbc_supervised_contact. 'pgym' scores ProteinGym DMS variants zero-shot, 'pbc_zeroshot_contact' predicts contact maps from the categorical Jacobian, 'pbc_supervised_contact' fits a probe on the attention maps, and 'pbc_supervised' trains task heads on the frozen encoder's embeddings.

pbc_supervised_datasets.description: Which PBC_SUPERVISED datasets to run, when 'pbc_supervised' is in `framework`. The framework holds seven task heads and embeds every sequence they need, which is ~13 min and ~30 GB of per-residue embeddings for the full set; the standing battery only wants two of them, so the default restricts it. 'all' or [] runs every dataset; a single name may be given as a bare string, and names are matched case-insensitively. None here also means every dataset, but null in YAML keeps this default: the YAML loader drops null values for every eval key. secondary_structure -> carries the newPISCES364 test split scl                 -> subcellular location

output_dir.description: Directory where autoeval results and per-framework outputs are written.

device.description: Device override. When None, picks 'cuda' if available else 'cpu'.

embedder_name.description: Embedder name shown in the autoeval report and in its filename. When None, defaults to '<run-dir>-ckpt<step>' resolved from the checkpoint, so two runs evaluated into one output_dir do not overwrite each other's report; a role-named checkpoint takes its step from training_state.json.

zero_shot_method.description: Zero-shot scoring method for the 'pgym' framework. One of: masked_marginals, wt_marginals, pseudoperplexity. Ignored by pbc_zeroshot_contact, which always uses the categorical Jacobian, and by pbc_supervised, which trains on embeddings.

zero_shot_batch_size.description: Sequences scored per forward pass. Masked-marginals masks one position at a time, so this batches that many masked positions into a single forward (biotrainer scores them one-by-one); it also sizes the Jacobian batches and the pbc_supervised embedding batches.

development_mode.description: Evaluate on subsampled task sets instead of the full benchmark. Much faster; use false for final numbers.

dataset_dir.description: Pre-downloaded benchmark dataset directory, passed to biotrainer as custom_storage_path. Set this on machines without internet access, and while ~/.cache/biotrainer/autoeval holds datasets from biotrainer < 2.1. Mutually exclusive with force_download.

force_download.description: Delete the whole ~/.cache/biotrainer/autoeval directory and download the datasets again. For a fresh copy elsewhere, use an empty dataset_dir.

loop_count.description: Refinement depth to run this checkpoint at, overriding the depth it was trained with. None = the depth in the checkpoint's model_config.yaml. Works for both loopie and huginn checkpoints; a checkpoint with no looping rejects it.

torch_compile.description: Run the model through torch.compile. Zero-shot scoring is thousands of forward passes, and eager spends only ~28% of its time in matmuls: the rest is unfused elementwise work (RoPE, gating, residuals). Compiling fuses it and roughly doubles throughput (185k -> 375k tok/s on a GH200). Compiled with dynamic shapes, because every protein is a different length; warmup is a few seconds and does not recur per shape.
